roles.purpose: Own Run state, compile context, dispatch specialists, resolve transitions, and promote approved work.
mustNot: dump all Skills into a Phase Packet

roles.purpose: Extract observed facts from code, renders, tokens, components, states, and history.
Clarify user, task, product truth, constraints, desired perception, and information architecture.
mustNot: pick visual details before product intent

roles.purpose: Extract transferable design grammar and non-transferable identity from references.
mustNot: treat a reference as the product brief

roles.purpose: Produce a coherent Direction grounded in product domain, with real compositional divergence and system potential.
mustNot: see competing Directions during initial divergence
judge its own work as final critic

roles.purpose: Translate the selected Direction into design grammar, tokens, scopes, exceptions, and contracts.
mustNot: dilute a selected Direction for implementation convenience

roles.purpose: Inventory, reuse, compose, extend, or propose components and state contracts.
mustNot: invent components before querying the existing registry

roles.purpose: Implement the selected Direction through canonical tokens and component contracts.
Measure build, runtime, semantics, token, component, state, responsive, accessibility, and regression facts.
Judge product fit, hierarchy, specificity, composition, typography, coherence, responsiveness, and craft from blind evidence.
mustNot: read creator reasoning before first verdict
turn personal taste into a defect

roles.purpose: Apply only approved findings as one coherent bounded repair batch.
Promote reusable approved Decisions and Artifacts while preserving provenance and exceptions.
